header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَمَا كَانَ اللهُ مُعَذِّبَهُمْ وَهُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: And Allah is not one to punish them while they are seeking forgiveness.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (ثُمَّ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِينَ عَمِلُوا السُّوءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا إِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنْ م بَعْدِهَا لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Then, indeed, your Rabb - for those who did evil out of ignorance and then, after that, repented and reformed (themselves) - is for such people; indeed your Rabb, after that, is Most Forgiving and Most Merciful.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (لَوْ لَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ اللهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: He said, “Why do you not seek forgiveness from Allah so that you may receive mercy?”

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَتُوبُوا إِلَي اللهِ جَمِيعاً أَيُّهَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O believers, turn back to Allah, all of you, seeking forgiveness, so that you may succeed.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (يَاأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا تُوبُوا إِلَي اللهِ تَوْبَةً نَّصُوحاًط۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: O you who believe, seek forgiveness from Allah with sincere repentance.
